instructions.scope: Saved inputs from this run only. No downloads, smoothing or Dupire. Four modules: volatility_surface (workflow), surface_model (math), surface_checks (validation/permission), surface_reporting (report/plots).
instructions.fit: European options only. Dates and upstream curves must agree. Raw SVI and optional SSVI retain their existing fit and arbitrage constraints; no automatic model fallback.
instructions.quality: Live practical coverage requires all three outside-spread limits per quote plus the expiry RMSE gate. Strict coverage is diagnostic. Historical closes retain RMSE-only assessment, without invented spreads.
instructions.stability: Required numerical refits and derivative sensitivity must pass. Missing evidence blocks eligibility. Timing subsets are diagnostics; shared-domain comparisons never validate omitted wings.
instructions.derivative_diagnostics: Prototype score=abs(change)/(absolute_tolerance+relative_tolerance*max(abs(values))). Review when P95>maximum_p95_score or maximum>maximum_score. Maturity jumps are measured at three shrinking offsets; their estimates must converge. These bands are not universal standards.
instructions.eligibility: Only explicit approximation permissions may turn limitations into warnings. Essential checks cannot be waived. Permission covers the intersection of baseline and numerical-refit domains; exact maturity knots and extrapolation are excluded. Every derivative stencil must remain in one open interval. Eligibility is not local-volatility implementation or simulation approval.
instructions.diagnostics: extended=false skips the optional SSVI comparison, quote-conditioning, forward-bump, timing-correlation and interval-feasibility research tables. It does not disable fitting, price quality, arbitrage, coverage, refit or derivative safeguards.
instructions.outputs: Read report.html for the decision, essential checks, domain and warnings. eligibility.json is the machine-readable permission; detailed CSVs and manifest retain evidence/settings. Earlier archives and reports are not overwritten.
